question: Which among the following produces bile in the human body?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Liver**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bile juice** is a fluid that's **made and released by the liver**.
 
• It is stored within the **gallbladder**.
 
• Bile juice breaks down** fats into fatty acids **and thus **helps in digestion**.
 
• 
 
Bile contains** cholesterol, Bile acids, Bilirubin.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The liver** is the **largest internal organ **of the human body.
 
• The five major functions of the liver include:
 
• **Filtration.**
 
• **Digestion.**
 
• **Metabolism and Detoxification.**
 
• **Protein synthesis.**
 
• **Storage of vitamins and minerals.**
